text.en: Pet owners frequently commend Dr. Kothmann, Dr. LaBrie, and the clinic team for their kindness, patience, and attentive bedside manner. Reviewers highlight how supportive the staff remained during sudden pet emergencies and end-of-life care. Clients consistently feel respected and well informed throughout their animals' clinical treatments.

Clients consistently note the gentle and loving care provided to canine patients, including aging dogs requiring palliative support. Owners appreciate thoughtful gestures such as painted paw prints and keepsake fur bags during bereavement. With the exception of one negative comment opposing euthanasia, animal welfare is universally praised.

Reviewers report successful surgical outcomes and prompt life-saving care when pets ingested harmful objects or suffered acute collapse. Most clients describe smooth recoveries and complete satisfaction with veterinary procedures, although one reviewer expressed general objection to euthanasia services. Clinical outcomes are viewed very positively overall.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate same-day pet emergencies?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that the veterinary team accommodated critical walk-in emergencies and urgent end-of-life cases within the hour.

q.en: How do clients rate the surgical fees at the hospital?

a.en: Pet owners praise the hospital for fair and transparent pricing, noting fees were significantly lower than nearby competitors.

q.en: What bereavement support is provided for grieving owners?

a.en: The clinic provides compassionate end-of-life care, including thoughtful keepsake paw prints and gentle support throughout.

q.en: Are routine surgical procedures performed on site?

a.en: Yes, clients report smooth surgical procedures and straightforward post-operative recovery for family dogs.
